metadata.title: MME Group — Exterior Renovation · South Florida
metadata.description: New roofing, stucco, paint, pressure cleaning, and driveways across Miami-Dade and Broward — one licensed local crew, done right the first time.

hero.sub: New roofing, stucco, paint, pressure cleaning, and driveways — handled by one local crew, done right the first time.

roofing.title: It starts at the top.
roofing.body: Tile, shingle, and flat roofs built to pass inspection and survive hurricane season.

stucco.title: Walls made flawless.
stucco.body: Cracks sealed, texture matched, finish even — installation and repair that disappears into the wall.

painting.title: A fresh coat changes everything.
painting.body: Interior and exterior, prepped and primed, with coatings rated for the Florida sun.

pressure.title: Years of grime, gone.
pressure.body: Pressure washing and gentle soft washing for roofs, walls, driveways, and pavers.

driveways.title: Arrive on something better.
driveways.body: Pavers, poured concrete, and resurfacing that lifts the whole front of the house.

more.title: And everything in between.
more.body: One crew for the whole exterior — so the finish lines up and the timeline stays yours.

hero.finalBody: Free estimates. Honest pricing. We answer in English y en español.

services.title: Six ways we lift your curb appeal
services.sub: From a brand-new roof to the driveway you park on — one accountable crew for the entire exterior.

roofing.title: New Roofing
roofing.desc: Tile, shingle & flat-roof installation and replacement, built to code and to last.

stucco.title: Stucco
stucco.desc: Seamless stucco installation and crack repair with texture matched to your home.

painting.title: Painting
painting.desc: Prep, prime, and premium coatings — interior and exterior, finished clean.

pressure.title: Pressure Cleaning
pressure.desc: Pressure washing and gentle soft washing for roofs, walls, drives, and pavers.

driveways.title: Driveways
driveways.desc: Paver, concrete, and resurfacing driveways that transform your entrance.

more.title: & More
more.desc: General exterior remodeling — if it's on the outside of your home, we handle it.

why.title: A major home investment deserves a crew you can trust
why.sub: We're local, accountable, and bilingual — and we treat your home like it's on our own street.

licensed.title: Licensed & Insured
licensed.desc: Fully licensed, bonded, and insured. Every crew member is covered on your property.

experience.title: 10+ Years Experience

guarantee.title: Satisfaction Guarantee
guarantee.desc: We're not done until you're happy. Clean job sites and work we stand behind.

local.title: Local to South Florida
local.desc: Born and based here. We know the codes, the climate, and the neighborhoods.

testimonials.title: Trusted by South Florida homeowners

items.maria: “MME re-roofed our home and repainted the whole exterior. Professional, on time, and they explained everything in Spanish. The house looks brand new.”
items.carlos: “Got a stucco repair and pressure washing done. Fair price, clean work, and you can't even tell where the old cracks were.”
items.jennifer: “New paver driveway completely changed the front of our house. The crew was respectful and finished ahead of schedule.”
